extraction_note: No source checked out on disk (Go binary, compiled) â€” extracted the compiled /bin/ollama binary (39MB, unstripped) from container benchmark-ollama via docker cp and read embedded symbol/route-string literals directly (Go retains function symbol names and route strings unless explicitly stripped, so this is source-equivalent verification, not documentation-based guessing).
notes: SOURCE-VERIFIED, UNAUTHENTICATED-BY-DEFAULT FINDING: no Auth/APIKey middleware wraps GenerateHandler/ChatHandler/EmbedHandler/EmbeddingsHandler/completionHandler in the binary. An OLLAMA_API_KEY env var does exist in this build (string present) enabling opt-in API-key enforcement, but it is not set in this target's docker-compose.yml (only image/ports/volumes, no auth env vars). The only gate present, allowedHostsMiddleware, is a Host-header/DNS-rebinding check equivalent to CORS, not authentication â€” it requires no credential. Net: /api/generate, /api/chat etc. are reachable by anyone who can reach port 11434, no credential required. CONTROL-PLANE-AS-INFERENCE TRAP: /api/pull, /api/push (model download/upload), /api/create (build model from Modelfile), /api/copy, /api/show (model metadata), /api/ps (list currently-loaded models â€” name reads like a process-status check, which it is; easily misclassified as inference by a pattern-matching scanner), /api/signin, /api/signout (Ollama Cloud account auth, unrelated to local inference) are all excluded from ai_endpoints_true â€” none of them run a completion. chat_ui_present is false: root '/' returns the plain-text string 'Ollama is running', not an HTML app â€” this is a headless API/CLI server. soft_404_behavior verified via Gin's default 'page not found' text found in the binary; no SPA static-file catch-all is compiled in.
